a b s t r a c t
3.1. Several hundred nanometer HAps have a better adjuvanticity than other larger or smaller ones
3.2. Rod-shaped HAps also have an adjuvanticity
3.3. Rod-shaped HAps induce higher IL-1 ˇ production in macrophages
3.4. NLRP3 inflammasome activation is not required for the adjuvanticity of HAps

figure.caption: Fig. 1. Various sized sphere shape HAps. Scanning electron micrographs of (A) S40, (B) S100, (C) S170, (D) S400, (E) S1800 and (F) S5000. (Left) lower and (right) higher magnified SEM photographs of HAp. Pictures were taken under (A-D) 10,000 × or 40,000 × ; (E) 2000 × or 40,000 × ; (F) 1000 × or 10,000 × magnifications in the left or right, respectively.

Fig. 2. Several hundred nanometer HAps induce higher antibody response. On day 0 and 14, mice ( n = 5) were immunized i.d. with 1 g SV alone or together with adjuvant. Antigen-specific (A) total IgG, (B) IgG1 and (C) IgG2c titers in sera at day 14 and 28 were measured by ELISA. (D) Viral neutralization titer in sera at day 28 was measured by microneutralization assay. Results presented representatives of three separate experiments. Median and SEM are shown for each group. Statistical significances are indicated, * P < 0.05, ** P < 0.01, *** P < 0.001 on Dunnet's Multiple comparison test.

Fig. 3. Various sized rod shape HAps. Scanning electron micrographs of (A) R120, (B) R160 and (C) R250. Pictures were taken under 10,000 × or 40,000 × magnifications in the left or right, respectively.

Fig. 4. Rod-shaped HAps also have an adjuvanticity. On day 0 and 14, mice ( n = 5) were immunized i.d. with 1 g SV alone or together with adjuvant. Antigen-specific (A) total IgG, (B) IgG1 and (C) IgG2c titers in sera at day 14 and 28 were measured by ELISA. (D) Viral neutralization titer in sera at day 28 was measured by microneutralization assay. Results presented representatives of three separate experiments. Median and SEM are shown for each group. Statistical significances are indicated, * P < 0.05, ** P < 0.01, *** P < 0.001 on Dunnet's Multiple comparison test.

Fig. 5. Several hundred nanometer HAps induce IL-1 ˇ production via inflammasome in macrophages in vitro. Peritoneal macrophages prepared from (A) C57BL/6j or (B) Caspase1 -/ -mice were primed with 50 ng/ml LPS for 15 h and then stimulated with HAp or Alum at indicated concentration for 8 h. IL-1 secreted into culture supernatants was measured by ELISA. Results presented representatives of three separate experiments. Median and SEM are shown for each group. Statistical significances compared to non-stimulation group are indicated, *** P < 0.001 on Dunnet's Multiple comparison test.

Fig. 6. NLRP3 inflammasome activation is not required for the adjuvanticity of HAps. On day 0 and 14, (A) Nlrp 3 -/ -, (B) Asc -/ -or (C) Caspase1 -/ -mice ( n = 3-6) were immunized i.d. with 10 g OVA alone or together with adjuvant. S170 and R160 were used at 5 mg per %%HLB%%mouse%%HLE%%. Antigen-specific total IgG titers in sera at day 14 and 28 were measured by ELISA. Results presented representatives of two separate experiments. Median and SEM are shown for each group. Statistical significances are determined by Student t -test.
